articleTitle: Hidden Curriculum and Character Building on Self-Motivation based on K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: Who is the controls information, he can controls the world. Therefore, the students must be able to process information into something useful for the learning process. The use of information technology in learning influences hidden curriculum factors that will be given to students. The purpose of this research is to find out the effect of hidden curriculum (X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) and character building (X2) variables on self-motivation in college students (Y). The samples are 38 student activists joined under KSR PMI State University of Malang unit and were taken using quota random sampling. The research instrument used is rating scale multiple choice questions. To determine the contribution of hidden curriculum (X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) and character building (X2) to self-motivation (Y), clustering techniques are conducted using the K-means algorithm. The result shows significant effects of hidden curriculum (X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) and character building (X2) variables on the self-motivation in college students (Y). Effective contribution from both predictors (X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and X2) to self-motivation (Y) is 60.53%, while 39.47% is influenced by other factors.

articleTitle: Comparative performance between C4.5 and Naive Bayes classifiers in predicting student academic performance in a Virtual Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: People now trying to maximizing function of Virtual Learning Environment. Virtual Learning Environment, not only as a place to help learning system but now has become a place of learning itself. But with the change of the learning system, teacher now have difficulty to monitor the activity of the student and the learning material. Although there is data that is considered capable become a benchmark for students and the interaction with Virtual Learning Activity. This paper will make a data prediction using Naïve bayes and C4.5 Algorithm using the Web History data and the sum of webpage interaction of the students in Virtual Learning Environment.

articleTitle: K-Means Clustering of Student Perceptions on Project-Based Learning Model Application
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: Project-based learning model is a learning model that emphasizes students to understand concepts, principles, investigation, decisions and represent products. This model is the right learning method used in various disciplines because it can improve thinking skills. This study aims to describe students' perceptions of the application of project-based learning models in the training program design and strategy courses by clustering data using the K-Means method. The result of the study shows that of the four clusters, they strongly agree, agree, disagree and strongly disagree, cluster 1 (agree) has the most data, namely 18 data indicating that the student agrees Project-based learning models are able to provide satisfaction when the project is complete, innovative learning models, practice project management skills, train a culture of cooperation, minimize the dominance of lecturers in learning, oriented to the optimization of potential students, practice creative thinking skills, practice cognitive skills in analytical material needs, design, development, implementation and evaluation of education and training programs, equip cognitive, affective and psychomotor skills as well as challenging learning skills, so that it is suitable to be applied in the lecture design and strategy courses.

articleTitle: The Use of Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System in Determining Students' Suitable High School Major
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: Selection of majors in high school is a complex problem experienced for high school students, because it must be in line with students' interests and talents; especially the selection of majors for high school students is the beginning of the career selection for their education level in the future. Therefore, it is necessary to do a classification using certain method for the best decision. Various data mining methods have been widely used for solving problems such as Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), C4.5, Fuzzy Multi Criteria Decision Making (FMCDM), forward chaining, fuzzy logic, Case-Based Reasoning (CBR), Simple Additive Weight (SAW), and adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system. This study used adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system to decide the high school students major. The obtained results are 95.3% of accuracy, 92% of precision, and 93.1% of sensitivity.

articleTitle: Learn Arabic Language App, Mobile Based Application for Self-Directed Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: It is common cases when students need a remedial learning process because they do not meet the learning achievement standards. The remedial process requires time and effort for both teacher and student. Some teachers prefer to lets their student doing self-directed learning. The teacher gives the material and direction in the classroom, then the students learn off-class. The face-to-face process is again conducted to evaluate the students' achievements. This learning method called with the flipped-class learning method. The method needs learning media that are appropriate for the self-directed learning process. This study aimed to develop a mobile application that can be used as self-directed learning media. Learn Arabic Language App (LALA) was developed by adopting the learning process in regular face-to-face class which is listening, understanding words/sentences meaning and writing in Arabic. LALA was tested for its usability (ease of use) to 16 students of a 4th-grade elementary school. The testing results show that LALA is very easy to use tool for self-directed learning. From the LALA development process, it is known the potential of mobile applications and game elements that can be designed and developed for self-directed learning.

articleTitle: Automatic Online News Feeding in Student Organization Website Using Word Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: News is important information to know what events occur every day among the community. The Internet makes news spread wider and faster. So that it can help people read news anywhere and anytime easily. But there are often many news on internet that are still not categorized according to the news content. Grabbing method will takes news' important information from online media. The news that has been taken will be categorized according to the news content using the text mining method. Word weighting or Term Frequency is one text mining method that can be used to categorize news because this method has high accurate, easy, and efficient results. This is proven by the results of research testing reaching an average accuracy of 95.2%.

articleTitle: Understanding of Digital Learning Sources with the Heutagogy Approach using the K-Means and Naive Bayes Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: The heutagogical approach is a learning approach that is consistent with the characteristics of independent students. This approach makes students become more active and independent in choosing, developing, and utilizing learning resources that are needed in the learning process. At the State University of Malang the heutagogical approach was carried out with digital learning sources in the form of the LSM SIPEJAR website and MOOC. On the website students can create and develop materials independently. The level of student understanding resulting from the learning process through the website will be evaluated using the k-means and naive bayes methods. Based on the results of clustering based on questionnaire data that has been distributed, obtained 3 classes in the form of students' level of understanding, namely Very Understanding, Understanding, and Understanding. This shows that the heutagogy approach in learning at Malang State University can improve students' understanding of the material being studied. While the results of the classification using Naive Bayes produce very good accuracy of 97.82%.

articleTitle: Teacher's Perceptions of Playful Learning Implementation using C-SVM Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to classify the teacher's perceptions of the implementation of playful learning in improving critical thinking skills. This study used the C-SVM method, which is a collaboration of the Support Vector Machine method with Correlation-based method to classify and map the tendency of teacher's perceptions as a criteria in measuring the level of critical thinking skills. The SVM method has the advantage of being able to map non-linear data into a high-dimensional feature space. This informs that SVM has the ability to generalize data. However, the SVM method has a less efficient data processing process, so a feature selection method is needed to help explore data accuracy efficiently. The feature selection method used was Correlation-based, because the approach taken is quite simple and efficient. This study used quantitative survey data regarding teacher perceptions of the implementation of playful learning. Based on the results of classification, many teachers' perceptions agree that playful learning can improve critical thinking skills with an accuracy value of 75% of data evaluation.

articleTitle: Classification using C4.5 on Student Capabilities Dataset
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: The transition from competition era to capability era is starting nowadays. It urges the student to also have capabilities of becoming something, not only the competitions. The need of capabilities for the development of students is to support the competition of profession. For that, curriculum of school is made to strengthen the capabilities. The objective of this research is to know impacts of the use of the said curriculum in capabilities of students as workers. There will be used datasets that is collected by sending out questioners about students' capabilities where the collected answers are grouped into S (Often), SS (Very Often) and J (Not Often). The classification itself will be one using one of Decision Tree's methods, C4.5, while the performance will be measured based on confusion matrix. From the result given, C4.5 with holdout shuffled sampling as its technique to validate the method classified the problem with 78.58% of accuracy. The generated tree of C4.5 shows few attributes that affected the capabilities level of students, which are the competencies of students, having ideas and active in activities.

articleTitle: Extent of Utilization, Viability and Effectiveness of E-Learning in the Camanava City Colleges: Basis for the Framework of E-Camanava
publicationTitle: 2018 4th International Conference on Education and Technology (ICET)
abstract: Filipinos greatly values education. This is proven thru numerous agencies and government institution that handles the policies and provisions for education. In the Philip-pine setting, universities and colleges are being founded by local city governments in order to offer education to the public. Education is leaning towards modernization. The use of computer technology is now a must for all colleges and universities as mandated by governing agencies. E-Learning is the new trend in education. It is based from the concepts of Computer Aided Instruction or Computer Aided Learning. In a basic sense, E-Learning is the use of computer systems and digital communications as tools of delivering instruction. Other countries have taken the initiative in this development in education. There are numerous E-Learning resources available in the Internet. This study examines if the educators in the Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas and Valenzuela (CAMANAVA) area are utilizing these tools, has it been effective, and is the practice feasible. The study used the five point Likert scale as the main tool of measurement. The study has tested the extent of utilization through assessing how often they use digital documents, multimedia and the Internet as an integrated tool in their teaching methodologies. Effectiveness is being evaluated in terms of convenience and increase in learners' performance. Also by assessing their willingness to use E-Learning tools, a perspective on its viability can be weighed. Based on the results and the survey for preferred features, a framework will be developed if a development for an E-Learning software is called for.
